run_say_tts: run say.py to convert text to speech using OpenAI TTS-1 with alloy voice
run_say_from_file: run say.py to convert text from a file to speech and save as mp3 output
run_say_with_voice: run say.py to generate speech with a custom voice and playback speed setting
run_say_streaming: run say.py to stream text-to-speech audio output to a specified filename
test_parse_args: test the parse_args function with custom model, voice, format, and speed arguments
